description: This Java class defines the HL7Source entity, representing a unique source location for HL7 messages within the OpenMRS system. It extends a base class for metadata and includes constructors, accessors, and mutators for the source ID.

classes.name: HL7Source
classes.description: Represents a unique source location for HL7 messages, including constructors, getter, and setter methods, and overrides for getId and setId.
